sources.quote: Kepler-37c is an exoplanet discovered by the Kepler space telescope in February 2013.

introduction.text: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-37. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: With an orbital period of 21 days, it is located 209 light-years away, in the constellation Lyra.
